reason: ModelOpt's documented PTQ Python API (mtq.quantize with INT8_DEFAULT_CFG and a calibration loop) runs on CPU with a tiny model and no gated downloads.
demo: README Install + Post Training Quantization guide (modelopt.torch.quantization mtq.quantize)
goal: Install nvidia-modelopt from the cloned repo (CPU-only torch, plus transformers) so that `import modelopt.torch.quantization as mtq` works. Then run post-training quantization: take a small Hugging Face causal LM (e.g. a tiny randomly initialised LlamaForCausalLM), call mtq.quantize(model, mtq.INT8_DEFAULT_CFG, forward_loop) with a calibration forward loop on CPU, and confirm the model has calibrated TensorQuantizer modules and still produces finite logits.
check: A hidden script quantizes a small Llama model with INT8_DEFAULT_CFG on CPU and verifies quantizers were inserted and calibrated and that outputs are finite and slightly different from the original.
